mechanism.name: Conditional CDF in Hall-Wolff-Yao sine regression with triangular noise

generation_equations.label: Source law and sampling (Example 1, unnumbered)
generation_equations.expression: X_i iid ~ f_T; epsilon_i iid ~ f_T; {X_i} independent of {epsilon_i}; f_T(u)=(1-|u|)1{-1<=u<=1}.

generation_equations.label: Equivalent-law RNG implementation (derived)
generation_equations.expression: For independent U_i1,...,U_i4 ~ Uniform(0,1): X_i=U_i1-U_i2; epsilon_i=U_i3-U_i4. Only X_i,Y_i are exported.

sampling.dependence: iid across rows; X_i independent of epsilon_i, while Y_i depends nonlinearly on X_i; no time-series or clustering structure in Example 1
sampling.n_semantics: n is the number of observed iid pairs requested by generate; seed is an implementation choice, not an original-paper seed

assumptions: Sampling: {(X_i,epsilon_i)} are iid across rows; the X and epsilon sequences are mutually independent, exactly as Example 1 specifies.
Observation: X and Y are fully observed numeric variables; there is no missingness, label selection, censoring or measurement-error mechanism.

Conditional-law identification: independent additive noise gives F(y|x)=G(y-m(x)). As P(X=0.1)=0, the target uses the continuous conditional-distribution version determined by this model; continuity and positive design density near the query select its point value.

Local regularity: f_X(0.1)=0.9>0 and z=1-m(0.1) lies strictly inside (0,1), away from the triangular mode and support knots. Thus 0<F<1 and F(1|x) is smooth in a neighborhood of x=0.1. No global smoothness at the triangular knots or uniform density lower bound near support endpoints is asserted.

Source Section 4 C1-C4 are estimator-specific regularity/kernel/bandwidth/dependence conditions. iid rows satisfy its absolute-regularity component; no fitted estimator, bandwidth asymptotics, or confidence-band result is validated here. No causal exchangeability or intervention assumptions apply.

properties.notes: One input covariate X, which is active through m(x)=2*sin(3.1416*x). Y is the outcome, not a second covariate. No covariate interaction terms and no padding variables. Additive homoskedastic triangular noise has variance 1/6 (derived), bounded support and density vanishing at endpoints. At the registered target f_Y|X(1|0.1)=0.6180353861199878>0. Independent noncausal regression; no confounding dimension. Scalar checks do not validate simultaneous bands.

estimand.name: theta = F_{Y|X=0.1}(1)
estimand.definition: P(Y<=1 | X=0.1) in the Example 1 superpopulation, using the continuous version F(y|x)=G(y-2*sin(3.1416*x)) induced by independent triangular noise. Conditional CDF, not a marginal CDF, quantile, conditional mean, causal contrast, or prediction interval. Query x=0.1 and CDF threshold y=1 are fixed in config.

truth.expression: P(Y<=1 | X=0.1) in the Example 1 superpopulation, using the continuous version F(y|x)=G(y-2*sin(3.1416*x)) induced by independent triangular noise. Conditional CDF, not a marginal CDF, quantile, conditional mean, causal contrast, or prediction interval. Query x=0.1 and CDF threshold y=1 are fixed in config.
truth.derivation: Closed-form integral of f_e(u)=1-|u| on [-1,1], shifted by m(x). Independent 80-digit Decimal Taylor sine plus Simpson integration of the shifted density, split at its mode, and rational x=0 anchors.

adaptations: Preserve the full Example 1 observed-data mechanism, including the literal frequency 3.1416, two independent iid triangular sequences, amplitude 2, support [-1,1] and unit noise scale.

Restrict the paper's conditional distribution estimation task to scalar P(Y<=1|X=0.1). The paper considers x=0.1, but selecting y=1 as the sole target is this contribution's adaptation; its numerical truth is derived here, not a reported paper result.

Use the API's caller-supplied sample size and local seeded Python RNG. The requested n=128, seed=1729 check does not reproduce the paper's 400/200 experiments at n=600 or its MADE, bandwidth, estimator and bootstrap comparisons.
Generate triangular variables as differences of independent uniforms; this is an equivalent-law implementation choice, not a claim about the authors' RNG or code.
